story.title: Prediction: A $10,000 Investment in This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Hardware Stock Will At Least Double by 2030 (Hint: It’s Not Nvidia or Micron) - The Motley Fool

facts.text: A just over $10,000 investment (27 shares) would be worth between $23,200 and $31,000 in 2031.
That's between a 130% return at the low end and a more than 200% gain at the high end.
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
The Motley Fool Stock Advisor analyst team just identified what they believe are the 10 best stocks for investors to buy now… and Broadcom wasn't one of them.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
The company has projected that its ASIC revenue will double next year to $115 billion.
It then expects that number to double again to $230 billion in fiscal 2028.
Broadcom said that Anthropic will account for about 10 gigawatts of power in 2028 and OpenAI for 5 gigawatts, while Meta will deploy around 3 gigawatts through 2028.
It estimated that it is getting between $20 billion and $30 billion in content per gigawatt, so these are all huge deals.

Broadcom helped Alphabet develop its highly successful Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), and this will be its biggest growth driver in the coming years, with Alphabet and Anthropic as its two most important TPU customers.
With Broadcom potentially tripling over the next five years, the AI stock looks like a solid buy at current levels.
An investment of $10,000 in Nvidia stock made five years ago is now worth an impressive $102,000.
Meanwhile, Micron has turned a similar investment into nearly $135,000 over the same period.
The strong earnings growth rate of these semiconductor stocks , along with their attractive valuations, is likely to lead to more gains by 2030.
However, there's another emerging AI hardware play that could make investors significantly richer by the end of the decade.
Harsh Chauhan has no position in any of the stocks mentioned.
The Motley Fool has positions in and recommends Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Platforms, Micron Technology, and Nvidia.
Jabil ( JBL -2.30% ) is a contract electronics manufacturer that designs, engineers, and manufactures electronic components and hardware for multiple industries.
AI has supercharged its growth, and I won't be surprised to see the stock doubling by 2030.
AI pioneer Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang estimates that AI infrastructure spending could reach $3 trillion to $4 trillion by 2030.
As server racks, cooling systems, and power management solutions play a critical role in AI data centers, the demand for Jabil's offerings should continue improving.
The chart above indicates that the company could report $25.93 in earnings per share in fiscal 2029 (ending in August 2029).
If this AI stock trades at even 22 times earnings at that time, in line with the tech-laden Nasdaq-100 index's forward earnings multiple, its stock price could reach $660.
